questions.question:
Mediterranean Sea is a border of which of the following countries?
1. Jordan
2. Iraq
3. Lebanon
4. Syria
Select the correct answer using the code given below:
questions.explanation: Lebanon and Syria have Mediterranean coastlines; Jordan and Iraq do not.

questions.question: Which one of the following countries of South-West Asia does not open out to the Mediterranean Sea?
questions.explanation: Jordan opens to the Gulf of Aqaba in the Red Sea, not the Mediterranean.
